title: A couple sells fake Taylor Swift tickets – level 1
paragraphs: A woman and her husband in Canada steal money from more than 100 people. They sell fake tickets for a big Taylor Swift concert in Toronto. They take 265,000 dollars.

Many parents buy the tickets for their children. People find out that the tickets are fake just before the concert. They are very sad. The couple says sorry. They use the money to gamble online. Lawyers want the couple to stay at home for punishment instead of going to prison. Many people with the fake tickets are angry. They want them in prison. In December, we will know what will happen with them.

words.d: to risk money on a game or race
what happens to you when you break a rule
